chunks: We issued this command to him, that the rear of these [people] would be cut off at dawn.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'cut off at dawn' signify in the context of the destruction of 'Aad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the precision of divine decree, where the destruction of the 'Aad was not merely a possibility but a finalized command ('Qadna') executed at dawn, symbolizing the suddenness of divine justice. The phrase 'maqta'un' (cut off) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as indicating the complete eradication of their remaining strength and lineage, serving as a warning against prolonged arrogance despite prior warnings.
